title: Lollapalooza 2026: Here’s Where to Watch the Four-Day Music Festival Live Online for Free
summary: Starting on July 30, you can watch the Chicago-based festival with performances by Lorde, Charli xcx, Smashing Pumpkins, Tate McRae and others.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

With summer festival season well underway, Lollapalooza 2026 is one of the most-anticipated with a stellar lineup featuring headliners including Lorde, John Summit, Charli xcx, Smashing Pumpkins, Olivia Dean, Jennie, Tate McRae, The xx and others. Although last-minute Lollapalooza tickets are still available, fans who aren’t able to travel to Chicago don’t have to miss out on all the music action.

Starting on Thursday (July 30), Lollapalooza is available to livestream on Disney+ and Hulu throughout the entire four-day music festival. Check out a livestream schedule here .

Watch on Disney+

How to Watch Lollapalooza 2026 Online

Lollapalooza

Get Disney+

Get Disney+ and Hulu plans starting at $9.99 per month.

Disney+ plans start at $7.99 per month for the ad-supported plan, while you can go ad-free for $13.99 per month. For even more content, Disney+ offers a bundle with Disney+ and Hulu, which starts at $9.99 per month. You can add ESPN Unlimited to Disney+ and Hulu starting at $35.99 per month.

Meanwhile, if you’re not into ESPN Unlimited, you can add HBO Max to Disney+ and Hulu instead with prices starting at $19.99 per month.

EDITOR'S PICK

DirecTV

Get 5-Day Free Trial

Comes with a five-day free trial.

You can watch local networks, such as NBC, CBS and FOX, while you can watch many cable networks too, including FX, AMC, A&E, Bravo, Cartoon Network, ESPN, FS1, VH1, Fuse, CNN, Food Network, Lifetime, CNBC, BET, MTV, Paramount Network and many others.

T-Mobile

Get Hulu On Us

Experience Beyond, or All-In Home Internet

With prices starting at $70 per month, eligible T-Mobile “Experience Beyond” phone and “All-In Home Internet” members can get Hulu (with ads) included with their membership at no additional cost. This is one of the best ways to get Hulu, as well as Netflix and Apple TV, included with a phone or home internet service. Learn more about T-Mobile and Hulu here .
